raw_text: I tried finding a picture of a handwritten recipe from 2 years ago. I remembered it was written on blue paper on my kitchen counter, but searching 'recipe' gives me 500 random food photos and zero document results.

Search is terrible when you don't know the date. I wanted to show my friend a photo of a cafe we went to right after graduation in Goa. I typed 'Goa cafe' and got hundreds of results from 3 different trips because I couldn't filter by 'summer 2022'.

I took a screenshot of a medicine prescription last year when I was sick with flu. I can't remember the brand name, so I typed 'medicine', but Google Photos didn't pick up the handwritten text on the bottle label.
